title.zh: 卷九十八 志第四十六: 兵一
title.raw: 卷九十八 志第四十六: 兵一 Volume 98 Treatises 51: Military 1

sentences.zh: 兵者，先王所以威天下，而折奪奸宄、戡定禍亂者也。

translations.literal: As for the military, it is what the former kings used to awe all under Heaven, to crush and seize traitors and villains, and to pacify and settle disasters and turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare is what the sage kings of old employed to overawe the realm, to subdue treachery and villainy, and to quell rebellion and disorder.

sentences.zh: 三代之制遠矣，漢、唐而下，其法變更不一。

translations.literal: The institutions of the Three Dynasties are remote; from Han and Tang downward, their laws have changed without uniformity.
translations.idiomatic: The military institutions of the Three Dynasties lie far in the past; from the Han and Tang dynasties onward, regulations changed repeatedly and without fixed pattern.

sentences.zh: 大抵用得其道，則兵力富，而國勢強；

translations.literal: Generally, if employed according to the right way, then military strength is abundant and national power is strong;
translations.idiomatic: When military power is applied rightly, forces grow plentiful and the state grows strong;

sentences.zh: 用失其宜，則兵力耗，而國勢弱。

translations.literal: if employed contrary to what is fitting, then military strength is depleted and national power is weak.
translations.idiomatic: when it is misapplied, forces are drained and the state grows weak.

sentences.zh: 故兵制之得失，國勢之盛衰系焉。

translations.literal: Therefore whether military institutions succeed or fail is bound up with whether national power flourishes or declines.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the soundness of military institutions and the rise or fall of national power are inseparably linked.

sentences.zh: 考之國初，典兵之官，視兵數多寡，為爵秩崇卑，長萬夫者為萬戶，千夫者為千戶，百夫者為百戶。

translations.literal: Examining the beginning of the state, officials in charge of troops, according to whether the number of troops was many or few, received ranks noble or base: one commanding ten thousand men was a commander of ten thousand households; one commanding a thousand, of a thousand households; one commanding a hundred, of a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty, military commanders were ranked by the size of the forces they led: commanders of ten thousand men held the title Commander of Ten Thousand Households; those of a thousand, Commander of a Thousand Households; those of a hundred, Commander of a Hundred Households.

sentences.zh: 世祖時，頗修官制，內立五衛，以總宿衛諸軍，衛設親軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the time of Shizu, official institutions were considerably restored; within [the capital] the Five Guards were established to oversee all palace-guard armies, and each guard had a commander-in-chief of personal troops;
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Shizu, the government substantially reorganized its institutions: five palace guards were established within the capital to command all imperial guard forces, each guard headed by a commander-in-chief of personal troops;

sentences.zh: 外則萬戶之下置總管，千戶之下置總把，百戶之下置彈壓，立樞密院以總之。

translations.literal: outside, under commanders of ten thousand households were placed chief administrators, under those of a thousand households were placed chief captains, under those of a hundred households were placed suppressors, and the Bureau of Military Affairs was established to oversee them all.
translations.idiomatic: in the field, chief administrators served under commanders of ten thousand households, chief captains under commanders of a thousand, and suppressors under commanders of a hundred; a Bureau of Military Affairs was created to supervise the whole system.

sentences.zh: 遇方面有警，則置行樞密院，事已則廢，而移都鎮撫司屬行省。

translations.literal: When there was alarm on a frontier, a traveling Bureau of Military Affairs was established; when the affair was concluded it was abolished, and the Metropolitan Pacification Commission was transferred to belong to the traveling Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When a frontier emergency arose, a traveling Bureau of Military Affairs was set up; once the crisis passed it was dissolved, and the Metropolitan Pacification Commission was placed under the traveling Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶、百戶分上中下。

translations.literal: Commanders of ten thousand, a thousand, and a hundred households were divided into upper, middle, and lower grades.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders of ten thousand, a thousand, and a hundred households were each ranked in upper, middle, and lower grades.

sentences.zh: 萬戶佩金虎符，符趺為伏虎形，首為明珠，而有三珠、二珠、一珠之別。

translations.literal: Commanders of ten thousand households wore golden tiger tallies; the base of the tally was in the shape of a crouching tiger, the head was a bright pearl, and there were distinctions of three pearls, two pearls, and one pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders of ten thousand households carried golden tiger tallies: the base was shaped as a crouching tiger, the head bore a luminous pearl, and grades were distinguished by three, two, or one pearl.

sentences.zh: 千戶金符，百戶銀符。

translations.literal: Commanders of a thousand households had golden tallies; commanders of a hundred households had silver tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders of a thousand households carried gold tallies; commanders of a hundred households carried silver tallies.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶死陣者，子孫襲爵，死病則降一等。

translations.literal: If commanders of ten thousand or a thousand households died in battle, their descendants inherited the rank; if they died of illness, [the rank] was lowered one grade.
translations.idiomatic: When commanders of ten thousand or a thousand households fell in battle, their descendants inherited the rank; death from illness reduced the rank by one grade.

sentences.zh: 總把、百戶老死，萬戶遷他官，皆不得襲。

translations.literal: When chief captains or commanders of a hundred households died of old age, or when commanders of ten thousand households were transferred to other offices, none [of these ranks] could be inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Chief captains and commanders of a hundred households who died of old age, and commanders of ten thousand households who were transferred to other posts, could not pass their offices to heirs.

sentences.zh: 是法尋廢，後無大小，皆世其官，獨以罪去者則否。

translations.literal: This law was soon abandoned; afterward, regardless of rank high or low, all offices were hereditary, except for those removed on account of crime.
translations.idiomatic: This law was soon abandoned; thereafter offices at every rank became hereditary, except when an incumbent was removed for a crime.

sentences.zh: 若夫軍士，則初有蒙古軍、探馬赤軍。

translations.literal: As for soldiers, at first there were Mongol armies and tamachi armies.
translations.idiomatic: As for the soldiery, the dynasty initially fielded Mongol armies and tamachi cavalry.

sentences.zh: 蒙古軍皆國人，探馬赤軍則諸部族也。

translations.literal: Mongol armies were all countrymen; tamachi armies were the various tribal peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol armies were drawn from the ruling people; the tamachi from the various tribal confederations.

sentences.zh: 其法，家有男子，十五以上、七十以下，無眾寡盡簽為兵。

translations.literal: By their law, in every household with males aged fifteen and above and seventy and below, without regard to whether few or many, all were conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under this system, every household with males between fifteen and seventy was conscripted in full, regardless of how many sons it had.

sentences.zh: 十人為一牌，設牌頭，上馬則備戰鬥，下馬則屯聚牧養。

translations.literal: Ten men formed one platoon, with a platoon head appointed; mounted, they prepared for battle; dismounted, they gathered to pasture and rear [livestock].
translations.idiomatic: Ten men formed a platoon under a platoon head: mounted, they stood ready for combat; dismounted, they camped together to herd and raise livestock.

sentences.zh: 孩幼稍長，又籍之，曰漸丁軍。

translations.literal: When children grew somewhat older, they were again registered; these were called gradually-maturing troops.
translations.idiomatic: As boys grew older they were registered again as gradually-maturing troops.

sentences.zh: 既平中原，發民為卒，是為漢軍。

translations.literal: After the Central Plains were pacified, the people were levied as soldiers; these were called Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: After the conquest of China proper, Chinese subjects were drafted as soldiers—these were the Han armies.

sentences.zh: 或以貧富為甲乙，戶出一人，曰獨戶軍，合二三而出一人，則為正軍戶，余為貼軍戶。

translations.literal: Sometimes according to wealth households were graded as first or second class; one man was levied from a household—called a sole-household soldier; when two or three households together furnished one man, [the contributing household] was the principal military household and the rest were supplementary military households.
translations.idiomatic: Households were sometimes graded by wealth: a single household supplying one soldier was a sole-household levy; when two or three households together supplied one man, one became the principal military household and the others supplementary military households.

sentences.zh: 或以男丁論，嘗以二十丁出一卒，至元七年十丁出一卒。

translations.literal: Sometimes according to adult males, formerly one soldier was levied from twenty males; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan, one soldier from ten males.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes the levy was calculated by adult males: originally one soldier per twenty males; in the seventh year of the Zhiyuan era, one per ten.

sentences.zh: 或以戶論，二十戶出一卒，而限年二十以上者充。

translations.literal: Sometimes according to households, one soldier from twenty households, limited to those aged twenty and above to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes one soldier was levied from every twenty households, limited to men aged twenty or older.

sentences.zh: 士卒之家，為富商大賈，則又取一人，曰余丁軍，至十五年免。

translations.literal: In soldier households that were great merchant traders, yet another man was taken—called surplus-male troops—exempted after fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Soldier households that were wealthy merchants supplied an additional man as a surplus-male soldier, exempted after fifteen years of service.

sentences.zh: 或取匠為軍，曰匠軍。

translations.literal: Sometimes artisans were taken as soldiers—called artisan armies.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans were sometimes conscripted as artisan soldiers.

sentences.zh: 或取諸侯將校之子弟充軍，曰質子軍，又曰禿魯華軍。

translations.literal: Sometimes the sons and younger brothers of feudatory lords and officers were made to serve as soldiers—called hostage armies, also called tulughachi armies.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and younger brothers of princely commanders were sometimes conscripted as hostage troops, also known as tulughachi troops.

sentences.zh: 是皆多事之際，一時之制。

translations.literal: These were all institutions of a time of many affairs, temporary measures.
translations.idiomatic: All of these were expedients of a turbulent age, not enduring institutions.

sentences.zh: 天下既平，嘗為軍者，定入尺籍伍符，不可更易。

translations.literal: After all under Heaven was pacified, those who had once been soldiers were fixed in the household register and platoon tally, and could not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the realm was pacified, former soldiers were entered permanently in military household registers and platoon tallies and could not be reassigned.

sentences.zh: 詐增損丁產者，覺則更籍其實，而以印印之。

translations.literal: Those who fraudulently increased or decreased [the number of] males or property—when discovered, their true [numbers] were re-registered and stamped with a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who fraudulently altered the count of males or property was, when discovered, re-registered according to the true figures and marked with an official seal.

sentences.zh: 病死戍所者，百日外役次丁；

translations.literal: those who died of illness at garrison posts—after a hundred days the next adult male served;
translations.idiomatic: If a soldier died of illness at a garrison, the next adult male in the household took his place after a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 死陣者，復一年。

translations.literal: those who died in battle—a year's reprieve.
translations.idiomatic: If he fell in battle, the household received a year's reprieve before the next male was called up.

sentences.zh: 貧不能役，則聚而一之，曰合並；

translations.literal: if too poor to serve, [households] were gathered into one—called consolidation;
translations.idiomatic: Households too poor to furnish a soldier were consolidated into one levy, called consolidation.

sentences.zh: 貧甚者、老無子者，落其籍。

translations.literal: the extremely poor and the old without sons were struck from the register.
translations.idiomatic: The destitute and the elderly without sons were removed from the military register.

sentences.zh: 戶絕者，別以民補之。

translations.literal: When a household line was extinguished, civilians were separately used to fill the gap.
translations.idiomatic: When a military household died out, ordinary civilians were assigned to replace it.

sentences.zh: 奴得縱自便者，俾為其主貼軍。

translations.literal: Slaves who were permitted freedom at their own convenience were made to serve as supplementary soldiers for their masters.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves granted personal freedom were required to serve as supplementary soldiers for their former masters.

sentences.zh: 其戶逃而還者，復三年，又逃者杖之，投他役者還籍。

translations.literal: Households that fled and returned received a three-year reprieve; if they fled again they were beaten with the staff; those who entered other corvée were restored to the register.
translations.idiomatic: Fugitive households that returned were granted three years' reprieve; a second flight brought corporal punishment; those who had taken up other labor service were restored to the military register.

sentences.zh: 其繼得宋兵，號新附軍。

translations.literal: Subsequently they received Song troops, called newly-submitted armies.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops who submitted later were called the newly-submitted armies.

sentences.zh: 又有遼東之糺軍、契丹軍、女直軍、高麗軍，雲南之寸白軍，福建之畬軍，則皆不出戍他方者，蓋鄉兵也。

translations.literal: There were also in Liaodong the Jiu armies, Khitan armies, Jurchen armies, and Korean armies; in Yunnan the Cunbai armies; in Fujian the She armies—these all did not go out to garrison other regions; they were essentially local militia.
translations.idiomatic: In Liaodong there were Jiu, Khitan, Jurchen, and Korean troops; in Yunnan the Cunbai; in Fujian the She—all local forces that did not serve garrisons elsewhere, essentially militia.

sentences.zh: 又有以技名者，曰炮軍、弩軍、水手軍。

translations.literal: There were also those named for their skills: artillery armies, crossbow armies, and sailor armies.
translations.idiomatic: Others were named for specialized skills: artillery troops, crossbow troops, and naval troops.

sentences.zh: 應募而集者，曰答剌罕軍。

translations.literal: Those who assembled in response to recruitment were called darqan armies.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteers who answered the call to arms were called darqan troops.

sentences.zh: 其名數，則有憲宗二年之籍、世祖至元八年之籍、十一年之籍，而新附軍有二十七年之籍。

translations.literal: As for their registered numbers, there were registers of the second year of Xianzong, registers of the eighth year of Shizu's Zhiyuan era, registers of the eleventh year, and for newly-submitted armies registers of the twenty-seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: Their rolls included the register of the second year of Emperor Xianzong, those of the eighth and eleventh years of the Zhiyuan era under Emperor Shizu, and for the newly-submitted armies a register of the twenty-seventh year.

sentences.zh: 以兵籍系軍機重務，漢人不閱其數。

translations.literal: Because military registers concerned weighty military secrets, Han people did not inspect their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Because military registers touched vital state secrets, Han officials were not permitted to review the troop counts.

sentences.zh: 雖樞密近臣職專軍旅者，惟長官一二人知之。

translations.literal: Even among close ministers of the Bureau of Military Affairs whose duty was exclusively military affairs, only one or two chief officials knew.
translations.idiomatic: Even among the Bureau of Military Affairs' inner circle, whose sole charge was the armies, only one or two senior officials knew the true numbers.

sentences.zh: 故有國百年，而內外兵數之多寡，人莫有知之者。

translations.literal: Thus though the state endured a hundred years, no one knew how many or few were the internal and external troops.
translations.idiomatic: Thus for a century of rule, no one outside a tiny circle knew how large or small the dynasty's forces truly were.

sentences.zh: 今其典籍可考者，曰兵制，曰宿衛，曰鎮戍，而馬政、屯田、站赤、弓手、急遞鋪兵、鷹房捕獵，非兵而兵者，亦以類附焉，作《兵志》。

translations.literal: Now what can be examined in the records are: military institutions, palace guard, and garrison defense; while horse administration, military colonies, relay stations, archers, express-courier relay troops, and falconry hunting—though not military yet military in nature—are also appended by category; thus the Military Treatises are composed.
translations.idiomatic: The surviving records are organized under military institutions, palace guard, and frontier garrisons; horse administration, military colonies, relay stations, archers, express couriers, and falconry hunting—matters not strictly military yet bound to it—are appended by category in these Military Treatises.

sentences.zh: ○兵制

translations.literal: ○ Military Institutions
translations.idiomatic: ○ Military Institutions

sentences.zh: 七年七月，簽宣德、西京、平陽、太原、陜西五路人匠充軍，命各處管匠頭目，除織匠及和林建宮殿一切合幹人等外，應有回回、河西、漢兒匠人，並劄魯花赤及劄也、種田人等，通驗丁數，每二十人出軍一名。

translations.literal: Seventh year, seventh month: artisans of the five circuits of Xuande, Western Capital, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Shaanxi were conscripted as soldiers. It was ordered that everywhere the heads in charge of artisans, excepting weavers and all those engaged in building palaces at Karakorum and similar duties, all Muslim, Hexi, and Han artisans, together with darughachi, zhalughachi, and farming people, should have their adult males tallied in full; one soldier was levied from every twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, artisans from the circuits of Xuande, Western Capital, Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Shaanxi were drafted as soldiers. Local artisan overseers were ordered to register all Muslim, Hexi, and Han craftsmen, together with darughachi, zhalughachi, and farmers—excluding weavers and those building palaces at Karakorum—and to levy one soldier from every twenty adult males.

sentences.zh: 八年七月，詔：「燕京路保州等處，每二十戶簽軍一名，令答不葉兒統領出軍。

translations.literal: Eighth year, seventh month, an edict: "In Baozhou and other places of the Yanjing Circuit, one soldier is to be conscripted from every twenty households, and Tabuyir is to command them on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year, an edict declared: "In Baozhou and elsewhere in the Yanjing Circuit, levy one soldier from every twenty households and place them under Tabuyir's command for campaign.

sentences.zh: 真定、河間、邢州、大名、太原等路，除先簽軍人外，於斷事官忽都虎新籍民戶三十七萬二千九百七十二人數內，每二十丁起軍一名，亦令屬答不葉兒領之。」

translations.literal: In the circuits of Zhending, Hejian, Xingzhou, Daming, Taiyuan, and others, apart from those previously conscripted, from among the 372,972 persons in the newly registered civilian households of the judicial officer Huduhu, one soldier is to be levied from every twenty adult males, and these too are to be placed under Tabuyir's command."
translations.idiomatic: In the circuits of Zhending, Hejian, Xingzhou, Daming, Taiyuan, and others, apart from men already conscripted, levy one soldier from every twenty adult males among the 372,972 persons in the new civilian register of the judicial officer Huduhu, and assign them likewise to Tabuyir's command."

sentences.zh: 十三年八月，諭總管萬戶劉黑馬，據斜烈奏，忽都虎等元籍諸路民戶一百萬四千六百五十六戶，除逃戶外，有七十二萬三千九百一十戶，隨路總簽軍一十萬五千四百七十一名，點數過九萬七千五百七十五人，余因近年蝗旱，民力艱難，往往在逃。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, eighth month: Chief Administrator Commander Liu Heima was instructed that, according to Xielie's memorial, Huduhu and others had originally registered civilian households of the various circuits at 1,004,656 households; apart from fugitive households there were 723,910 households; along the circuits a total of 105,471 soldiers were conscripted, but the muster counted only 97,575 persons; the remainder, because in recent years there had been locusts and drought and the people's strength was hard pressed, were often fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year, Chief Administrator Commander Liu Heima was instructed that, per Xielie's memorial, Huduhu had originally registered 1,004,656 civilian households across the circuits; excluding fugitives, 723,910 remained. A total of 105,471 soldiers were conscripted, but muster rolls showed only 97,575 present—the rest, worn down by recent locust plagues and drought, had fled.

sentences.zh: 有旨，今後止驗見在民戶簽軍，仍命逃戶復業者免三年軍役。

translations.literal: An order was issued: hereafter only presently existing civilian households are to be verified for conscription; fugitive households that return to their occupations are exempted from military service for three years.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered that henceforth conscription would be based only on households actually present, and fugitives who returned to farming would be exempt from military service for three years.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，詔：「真定、彰德、邢州、洺磁、東平、大名、平陽、太原、衛輝、懷孟等路各處，有舊屬按劄兒、孛羅、笑乃<角┦>、闊闊不花、不裏合拔都兒等官所管探馬赤軍人，乙卯歲籍為民戶，亦有簽充軍者。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, an edict: "In various places of the circuits of Zhending, Zhangde, Xingzhou, Luoci, Dongping, Daming, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Weihui, Huaimeng, and others, there were tamachi soldiers formerly under the jurisdiction of officials such as Anzar, Boluo, Xiaonaijiao, Kuokuobuhua, and Bulihebaduer; in the yimao year they were registered as civilian households, and some were also conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, an edict declared: "In Zhending, Zhangde, Xingzhou, Luoci, Dongping, Daming, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Weihui, Huaimeng, and other circuits, tamachi soldiers formerly under commanders such as Anzar, Boluo, Xiaonaijiao, Kuokuobuhua, and Bulihebaduer had been registered as civilians in the yimao year; some had also been drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 若壬寅、甲寅兩次簽定軍，已入籍冊者，令隨各萬戶依舊出征；

translations.literal: As for soldiers fixed in the registers from the two conscriptions of renyin and jiayin, let them follow their respective commanders of ten thousand households on campaign as before;
translations.idiomatic: Those entered in the registers from the renyin and jiayin conscriptions should march under their respective commanders of ten thousand households as before;

sentences.zh: 其或未嘗為軍，及蒙古、漢人民戶內作數者，悉簽為軍。」

translations.literal: those who have never been soldiers, and those counted within Mongol and Han civilian households, are all to be conscripted as soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: those who have never served, and any counted within Mongol or Han civilian households, are all to be conscripted."

sentences.zh: 六月，以軍士訴貧乏者眾，命貧富相兼應役，實有不能自存者優恤三年。

translations.literal: Sixth month: because many soldiers complained of poverty, it was ordered that rich and poor should jointly fulfill service; those truly unable to support themselves were given preferential relief for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, because many soldiers petitioned about poverty, the court ordered that rich and poor households share the burden of service, and those genuinely unable to support themselves received three years' relief.

sentences.zh: 十月，諭山東東路經略司：「益都路匠軍已前曾經簽把者，可遵別路之例，俾令從軍。」

translations.literal: Tenth month: the Eastern Shandong Pacification Commission was instructed: "Artisan soldiers of the Yidu Circuit who were previously conscripted as platoon heads may follow the precedent of other circuits and be made to serve as soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Eastern Shandong Pacification Commission was told: "Artisan soldiers of the Yidu Circuit previously drafted as platoon heads should follow other circuits' precedent and be required to serve on campaign."

sentences.zh: 以鳳翔府屯田軍人準充平陽軍數，仍於鳳翔屯田，勿遣從軍。

translations.literal: The military-colony soldiers of Fengxiang Prefecture were approved to count toward the Pingyang quota; they were to remain farming colonies at Fengxiang and not be sent on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Military-colony troops of Fengxiang Prefecture were counted toward Pingyang's quota but were to remain at Fengxiang on colony duty and not be sent on campaign.

sentences.zh: 刁國器所管重簽軍九百一十五人，即日放罷為民。

translations.literal: The 915 doubly-conscripted soldiers under Diao Guoqi were on the same day released and made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The 915 men doubly conscripted under Diao Guoqi were immediately discharged and restored to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 陜西行省言：「士卒戍金州者，諸奧魯已嘗服役，今重勞苦。」

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported: "Soldiers garrisoning Jinchuan—the various ordu have already served; now they are doubly burdened and toiled."
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported: "The soldiers garrisoning Jinchuan—their home ordu have already served; they are now doubly overburdened."

sentences.zh: 詔罷之。

translations.literal: An edict abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the arrangement discontinued.

sentences.zh: 並罷山東、大名、河南諸路新簽防城戍卒。

translations.literal: At the same time the newly conscripted wall-defense garrison troops of Shandong, Daming, Henan, and other circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Newly conscripted wall-defense garrisons in Shandong, Daming, Henan, and other circuits were also abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，詔：「統軍司及管軍萬戶、千戶等，可遵太祖之制，令各官以子弟入朝充禿魯花。」

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, an edict: "The Army Command and commanders of ten thousand and a thousand households and others should follow the Grand Ancestor's institution and have each officer send sons and younger brothers to court to serve as tulughachi."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, an edict declared: "The Army Command and all commanders of ten thousand and a thousand households shall follow the Grand Ancestor's institution and send their sons and younger brothers to court as tulughachi hostages."

sentences.zh: 其制：萬戶，禿魯花一名，馬一十匹，牛二具，種田人四名。

translations.literal: The institution: for a commander of ten thousand households, one tulughachi, ten horses, two teams of oxen, and four farming people.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations: each commander of ten thousand households supplied one tulughachi, ten horses, two teams of oxen, and four farmers.

sentences.zh: 千戶見管軍五百或五百已上者，禿魯花一名，馬六匹，牛一具，種田人二名。

translations.literal: A commander of a thousand households who presently commanded five hundred troops or five hundred and above: one tulughachi, six horses, one team of oxen, and two farming people.
translations.idiomatic: A commander of a thousand households with five hundred or more troops under him supplied one tulughachi, six horses, one team of oxen, and two farmers.

sentences.zh: 雖所管軍不及五百，其家富強子弟健壯者，亦出禿魯花一名，馬匹、牛具、種田人同。

translations.literal: Even if the troops commanded were fewer than five hundred, if the family was wealthy and strong and the sons and younger brothers robust, one tulughachi was also furnished, with horses, oxen, and farming people the same.
translations.idiomatic: Even commanders with fewer than five hundred troops, if their families were wealthy and their sons robust, also supplied one tulughachi with the same horses, oxen, and farmers.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶子弟充禿魯花者，挈其妻子同至，從人不拘定數，馬匹、牛具，除定去數目已上，復增余者聽。

translations.literal: Sons and younger brothers of commanders of ten thousand and a thousand households serving as tulughachi brought their wives and children with them; attendants were not limited to a fixed number; for horses and oxen, beyond the stipulated quota additional surplus was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sons serving as tulughachi brought their wives and children; attendants were unlimited; horses and oxen beyond the stipulated quota were permitted.

sentences.zh: 若有貧乏不能自備者，於本萬戶內不該出禿魯花之人，通行津濟起發，不得因而科及眾軍。

translations.literal: If there were poor who could not provide for themselves, within that commander of ten thousand households those not obliged to furnish tulughachi were to assist them jointly in setting out; they must not on this account levy exactions on the mass of troops.
translations.idiomatic: If a family could not afford the equipment, others in the same command of ten thousand households who were not required to supply tulughachi were to assist them—but no levy could be imposed on the rank and file.

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶或無親子、或親子幼弱未及成人者，以弟侄充，候親子年及十五，卻行交換。

translations.literal: If a commander of ten thousand or a thousand households had no son, or the son was young and weak and had not yet reached adulthood, a younger brother or nephew served in his place; when the son reached fifteen years, the exchange was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders without sons, or whose sons were still minors, sent younger brothers or nephews in their place; when a son reached fifteen, the exchange was made.

sentences.zh: 若委有親子，不得隱匿代替，委有氣力，不得妄稱貧乏，及雖到來，氣力卻有不完者，並罪之。

translations.literal: If there truly was a son, he must not be concealed and a substitute sent; if there truly was strength, poverty must not be falsely claimed; and if though having come, one's strength was incomplete—all were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who concealed a son and sent a substitute, falsely claimed poverty when able-bodied, or arrived unfit for service—all were to be punished.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝以太宗舊制，設官分職，軍民之事，各有所司。

translations.literal: That month, the Emperor, following Taizong's old institutions, established officials and divided duties—military and civilian affairs each had its own charge.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Emperor restored Taizong's practice of separate offices for military and civilian administration.

sentences.zh: 後多故之際，不暇分別，命阿海充都元帥，專於北京、東京、平灤、懿州、蓋州路管領見管軍人，凡民間之事毋得預焉。

translations.literal: Later, in a time of many affairs, there was no leisure for distinction; Ahai was appointed Grand Marshal, exclusively in the circuits of Northern Capital, Eastern Capital, Pingluan, Yizhou, and Gaizhou to oversee the troops presently under command; he was not to intervene in any civilian matters.
translations.idiomatic: Later, amid constant emergencies, the distinction lapsed; Ahai was appointed Grand Marshal to command troops in the circuits of Northern Capital, Eastern Capital, Pingluan, Yizhou, and Gaizhou alone, with no authority over civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月，立樞密院，凡蒙古、漢軍並聽樞密節制。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Bureau of Military Affairs was established; all Mongol and Han armies alike were to obey the Bureau's control.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Bureau of Military Affairs was established; all Mongol and Han forces came under its authority.

sentences.zh: 統軍司、都元帥府，除遇邊面緊急事務就便調度外，其軍情一切大小公事，並須申覆。

translations.literal: The Army Command and the Grand Marshal's headquarters, except when frontier emergencies permitted immediate dispatch, for all military affairs great and small alike had to report for approval.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Command and Grand Marshal's headquarters could act on their own only in frontier emergencies; all other military business required approval from above.

sentences.zh: 合設奧魯官，並從樞密院設置。

translations.literal: The ordu officials to be established were all set up through the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ordu officials were to be established under the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔免河南保甲丁壯、射生軍三千四百四十一戶雜泛科差，專令守把巡哨。

translations.literal: Seventh month: an edict exempted the 3,441 households of Henan baojia able-bodied men and shooting troops from miscellaneous levies, assigning them exclusively to garrison and patrol duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an edict exempted 3,441 Henan baojia and shooting-troop households from miscellaneous levies, assigning them solely to garrison and patrol duty.

sentences.zh: 八月，諭成都路行樞密院：「近年軍人多逃亡事故者，可於各奧魯內盡實簽補，自乙卯年定入軍籍之數，悉簽起赴軍。」

translations.literal: Eighth month: the traveling Bureau of Military Affairs of the Chengdu Circuit was instructed: "In recent years many soldiers have fled or met with accidents; in each ordu replacements should be conscripted in full according to the true count; from those fixed in the military register in the yimao year, all are to be conscripted and sent to the armies."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the traveling Bureau at Chengdu was told: "Many soldiers have fled or died in recent years; each ordu should make up the full quota from those entered in the military register in the yimao year and send them to the armies."

sentences.zh: 十一月，女直、水達達及乞烈賓地合簽鎮守軍，命亦裏不花簽三千人，付塔匣來領之；

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Jurchen, Suichen, and Qiliebin lands together conscripted garrison troops; Yilibuhua was ordered to conscript three thousand men and hand them to Taxialai to command;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jurchen, Suichen, and Qiliebin territories jointly conscripted garrison troops; Yilibuhua was ordered to draft three thousand men for Taxialai to command;

sentences.zh: 並達魯花赤官之子及其餘近上戶內，亦令簽軍，聽亦裏不花節制。

translations.literal: and from among the sons of darughachi officials and other leading households, soldiers were also to be conscripted, under Yilibuhua's control.
translations.idiomatic: sons of darughachi officials and other leading households were also conscripted, all under Yilibuhua's authority.

sentences.zh: 至元二年八月，陜西五路西蜀四川行省言：「新簽軍七千人，若發民戶，恐致擾亂。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan second year, eighth month: the Branch Secretariat of the Five Circuits of Shaanxi, Western Shu, and Sichuan reported: "The newly conscripted seven thousand soldiers—if civilian households are levied, I fear disorder will result.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Zhiyuan, the Branch Secretariat for Shaanxi's five circuits and Western Shu and Sichuan reported: "The seven thousand newly conscripted soldiers—if we levy civilian households, we fear widespread disruption.

sentences.zh: 今鞏昌已有舊軍三千，諸路軍二千，余二千人亦不必發民戶，當以便宜起補。」

translations.literal: Now Gongchang already has three thousand old troops, the various circuits two thousand; the remaining two thousand also need not levy civilian households—replacements should be raised as convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang already has three thousand veteran troops and the circuits two thousand; the remaining two thousand need not come from civilians but should be filled as circumstances permit."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，省院官議，收到私走間道、盜販馬匹、曾過南界人三千八百四戶，悉令充軍，以一千九百七十八人與山東路統軍司，一千人與蔡州萬戶，余八百二十六戶，有旨留之軍中。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: provincial and bureau officials deliberated; 3,804 persons received for privately traveling bypaths, illicitly trading horses, and having crossed the southern border were all made to serve as soldiers—1,978 persons to the Shandong Circuit Army Command, 1,000 to the Caizhou commander of ten thousand households; the remaining 826 households—an order was issued to retain them in the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, provincial and central officials decided that 3,804 persons caught smuggling horses along secret routes and crossing the southern border would all be conscripted—1,978 to the Shandong Army Command, 1,000 to the Caizhou commander of ten thousand households; the remaining 826 households were ordered kept in military service.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，添內外巡軍，外路每百戶選中產者一人充之，其賦令余戶代輸，在都增武衛軍四百。

translations.literal: Third year, seventh month: patrol troops within and without were added; in outer circuits one man of middle property was selected from every hundred households; their tax levies the remaining households were made to pay in their stead; in the capital four hundred Martial Guard troops were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, patrol forces were expanded: in the provinces one man of middle means was selected per hundred households, with other households paying his taxes; four hundred Martial Guard troops were added in the capital.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，簽蒙古軍，每戶二丁、三丁者一人，四丁、五丁者二人，六丁、七丁者三人。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month: Mongol armies were conscripted—households with two or three adult males furnished one; with four or five, two; with six or seven, three.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Mongol troops were conscripted: households with two or three adult males supplied one soldier; with four or five, two; with six or seven, three.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔遣官簽平陽、太原人戶為軍，除軍、站、僧、道、也裏可溫、答失蠻、儒人等戶外，於系官、投下民戶、運司戶、人匠、打捕鷹房、金銀鐵冶、丹粉錫碌等，不以是何戶計，驗酌中戶內丁多堪當人戶，簽軍二千人，定立百戶、牌子頭，前赴陜西五路西蜀四川行中書省所轄東川出征。

translations.literal: Second month: an edict dispatched officials to conscript civilian households of Pingyang and Taiyuan as soldiers. Apart from military, relay, monk, Daoist, Nestorian, Muslim, and Confucian households, among government-attached households, appanage civilian households, transport-commission households, artisans, hunting and falconry households, gold, silver, and iron smelting, cinnabar, powder, tin, and similar—regardless of what household type—from middle households selecting those with many adult males fit for service, two thousand soldiers were conscripted; commanders of a hundred households and platoon heads were established, and they proceeded to campaign in Eastern Chuan under the jurisdiction of the Branch Secretariat of the Five Circuits of Shaanxi, Western Shu, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, officials were sent to draft soldiers from Pingyang and Taiyuan. Exempt were military, relay, monastic, Nestorian, Muslim, and Confucian households; from government, appanage, transport, artisan, hunting, mining, and similar households—regardless of category—two thousand men were selected from middle households with the most able-bodied sons, organized under commanders of a hundred households and platoon heads, and sent to campaign in Eastern Chuan under the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 復於京兆、延安兩路簽軍一千人，如平陽、太原例。

translations.literal: Again in the two circuits of Jingzhao and Yan'an one thousand soldiers were conscripted, following the Pingyang and Taiyuan precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Another thousand were drafted from the Jingzhao and Yan'an circuits on the same terms as Pingyang and Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔：「河南路驗酌中戶內丁多堪當軍人戶，簽軍四百二十名，歸之樞密院，俾從軍，復其徭役。

translations.literal: Fifth month, an edict: "In the Henan Circuit, from middle households selecting those with many adult males fit for military households, 420 soldiers are to be conscripted, assigned to the Bureau of Military Affairs, made to serve in the armies, and their corvée restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an edict declared: "In the Henan Circuit, select 420 soldiers from middle households with the most able-bodied sons, assign them to the Bureau of Military Affairs for campaign, and restore their corvée obligations.

sentences.zh: 南京路，除邳州、南宿州外，依中書省分間定應簽軍人戶，驗丁數，簽軍二千五百八十名，管領出征。」

translations.literal: In the Nanjing Circuit, apart from Pizhou and Nansuzhou, according to the Secretariat's division and determination of households that should furnish soldiers, verifying adult male numbers, 2,580 soldiers are to be conscripted and led on campaign."
translations.idiomatic: In the Nanjing Circuit, excluding Pizhou and Nansuzhou, levy 2,580 soldiers from households designated by the Secretariat, verified by adult male count, and lead them on campaign."

sentences.zh: 十二月，簽女直、水達達軍三千人。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: three thousand Jurchen and Suichen troops were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, three thousand Jurchen and Suichen troops were conscripted.

sentences.zh: 五年閏正月，詔益都李亶元簽軍，仍依舊數充役。

translations.literal: Fifth year, intercalary first month: an edict [declared that] Li Tan's originally conscripted soldiers of Yidu still serve according to the former quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month of the fifth year, an edict ordered that Li Tan's originally conscripted Yidu troops continue serving at their former strength.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔諸路奧魯毋隸總管府，別設總押所官，聽樞密院節制。

translations.literal: Second month: an edict [declared that] ordu of the various circuits are not subordinate to general administrations; separate chief-guard offices are to be established, under the Bureau of Military Affairs' control.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, an edict placed all circuit ordu under separate chief-guard offices answerable to the Bureau of Military Affairs, not to general administrations.

sentences.zh: 六月，省臣議：「簽起禿魯花官員，皆已遷轉，或物故黜退者，於內復有貧難蒙古人氏，除隨路總管府達魯花赤、總管及掌兵萬戶，合令應當，其次官員禿魯花，宜放罷，其自願留質者聽之。」

translations.literal: Sixth month: provincial ministers deliberated: "Tulughachi officials who were conscripted have all been transferred, or died or were dismissed; among them are again poor and distressed Mongol persons. Apart from the darughachi, chief administrators, and military commanders of ten thousand households of each circuit's general administration, who ought to fulfill their obligation, tulughachi of other officials should be released; those who voluntarily remain as hostages may do so."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, provincial ministers recommended: "Among tulughachi previously conscripted, many officers have been transferred, died, or dismissed, leaving poor Mongols in hardship. Only darughachi, chief administrators, and commanders of ten thousand households should remain obliged; other officials' tulughachi should be released, though those who wish to stay as hostages may do so."

sentences.zh: 十月，禁長軍之官不得侵漁士卒，違者論罪。

translations.literal: Tenth month: it was forbidden for officers who command troops to encroach on and exploit soldiers; violators were prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, officers were forbidden to exploit their soldiers; violators were prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 十一月，簽山東、河南沿邊州城民戶為軍，遇征進，則選有力之家同元守邊城漢軍一體出征，其無力之家代守邊城及屯田勾當。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: civilian households of frontier prefectures and cities of Shandong and Henan were conscripted as soldiers; when campaigns were undertaken, wealthy households were selected to campaign together with the original Han troops garrisoning frontier cities; powerless households garrisoned the frontier cities and performed military-colony duties in their stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, frontier civilian households in Shandong and Henan were conscripted: on campaign, wealthy households marched with the original Han frontier garrisons; poor households garrisoned the walls and worked military colonies in their place.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，簽懷孟、衛輝路丁多人戶充軍，益都、淄萊所轄登、萊州李鋋舊軍內，起簽一萬人，差官部領出征。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month: households with many adult males of the Huaimeng and Weihui circuits were conscripted as soldiers; from within Li Zhen's old troops of Deng and Laizhou under the jurisdiction of Yidu and Zilai, ten thousand men were raised and conscripted, and officials were dispatched to lead them on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, soldiers were drafted from households with many sons in the Huaimeng and Weihui circuits; ten thousand men were raised from Li Zhen's old Deng and Laizhou troops under Yidu and Zilai, and officials were sent to lead them on campaign.

sentences.zh: 其淄萊路所轄淄、萊等處有非李鋋舊管者，簽五百二十六人，其餘諸色人戶，亦令酌驗丁數，簽軍起遣，至軍前赴役。

translations.literal: In Zibo, Laizhou, and other places under the Zilai Circuit not formerly under Li Zhen's command, 526 persons were conscripted; the remaining households of various categories were also ordered to verify adult male numbers appropriately, conscript soldiers, dispatch them, and have them report for service before the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In Zibo, Laizhou, and elsewhere in the Zilai Circuit outside Li Zhen's former command, 526 men were drafted; other households of every category were likewise to furnish soldiers according to their adult male count and send them to the front.

sentences.zh: 十月，從山東路統軍司言，應系逃軍未獲者，令其次親丁代役，身死軍人亦令親丁代補，無親丁則以少壯驅丁代之。

translations.literal: Tenth month: following the Shandong Circuit Army Command's report, for fugitive soldiers not yet captured, the next closest adult male relative was to serve in their place; for soldiers who died, adult male relatives were also to replace them; if there were no adult male relatives, young and strong bonded servants were to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, following the Shandong Army Command's recommendation, fugitives not yet captured were replaced by the next closest adult male relative; dead soldiers were likewise replaced by relatives, or by young bonded servants if no relatives were available.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，定軍官等級，萬戶、千戶、百戶、總把以軍士為差。

translations.literal: Seventh year, third month: military officer grades were fixed—commanders of ten thousand, a thousand, and a hundred households and chief captains were differentiated by the number of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year, military ranks were fixed: commanders of ten thousand, a thousand, and a hundred households and chief captains were graded by the number of troops under their command.

sentences.zh: 六月，成都府括民三萬一千七十五戶，簽義士軍八千六十七人。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Chengdu Prefecture registered 31,075 civilian households and conscripted 8,067 volunteer troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Chengdu Prefecture registered 31,075 civilian households and drafted 8,067 volunteer soldiers.

sentences.zh: 七月，分揀隨路炮手軍。

translations.literal: Seventh month: artillery troops of the various circuits were sorted and selected.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, artillery soldiers from the various circuits were sorted and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 始太祖、太宗征討之際，於隨路取發，並攻破州縣，招收鐵木金火等人匠充炮手，管領出征，壬子年俱作炮手附籍。

translations.literal: At the beginning, when the Grand Ancestor and Taizong undertook campaigns, [troops] were levied from the various circuits; when prefectures and counties were captured, iron, wood, metal, fire, and other artisans were recruited as artillerymen and led on campaign; in the renyi year all were registered as artillery households.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor and Taizong first campaigned, artillerymen were levied from each circuit; captured towns supplied ironworkers, carpenters, metallurgists, and pyrotechnicians who marched with the armies. In the renyi year all were registered as artillery households.

sentences.zh: 中統四年揀定，除正軍當役外，其餘戶與民一體當差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongtong they were selected and fixed; apart from principal military households fulfilling service, the remaining households bore corvée together with civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhongtong the rolls were fixed: apart from principal military households on active duty, the rest bore corvée like ordinary civilians.

sentences.zh: 後為出軍正戶煩難，至元四年取元充炮手民戶津貼，其間有能與不能者，影占不便，至是分揀之。

translations.literal: Later, because campaign principal households found it burdensome, in the fourth year of Zhiyuan subsidies were taken from the original artillery civilian households; among them some were capable and some not, and shadow registration was inconvenient—therefore they were now sorted.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because principal campaign households found the burden onerous, in the fourth year of Zhiyuan subsidies were drawn from former artillery households; since some were skilled and others not, and false registration caused trouble, they were now sorted and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，以瓜州、沙州鷹房三百人充軍。

translations.literal: Eighth year, second month: three hundred falconry keepers of Guazhou and Shazhou were made to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year, three hundred falconry keepers from Guazhou and Shazhou were conscripted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，河南省請益兵，敕諸路簽軍三萬，詔元帥府、統軍司、總管萬戶府閱實軍籍。

translations.literal: Ninth year, first month: Henan Province requested additional troops; an order conscripted thirty thousand soldiers from the various circuits; an edict [ordered] the Marshal's headquarters, Army Command, and chief administrator commanders of ten thousand households to verify military registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, Henan Province requested reinforcements; thirty thousand soldiers were conscripted from the circuits, and the Marshal's headquarters, Army Command, and commanders of ten thousand households were ordered to verify the military registers.

sentences.zh: 二月，命阿術典行省蒙古軍，劉整、阿裏海牙典漢軍。

translations.literal: Second month: Aju was ordered to command the Branch Secretariat's Mongol armies; Liu Zheng and Alihaiya to command the Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Aju was placed in command of the Branch Secretariat's Mongol forces, and Liu Zheng and Alihaiya in command of the Han forces.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔：「諸路軍戶驅丁，除至元六年前從良入民籍者當差。

translations.literal: Fourth month, an edict: "Bonded servants of military households in the various circuits—except those who before the sixth year of Zhiyuan obtained good standing and entered civilian registers—shall bear corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, an edict declared: "Bonded servants of military households in the various circuits, except those who obtained freedom and entered civilian registers before the sixth year of Zhiyuan, shall bear corvée.

sentences.zh: 七年後，凡從良文書寫從便為民者，亦如之。

translations.literal: After the seventh year, all who obtained good standing with documents written at their convenience as civilians were likewise [to bear corvée].
translations.idiomatic: After the seventh year, those who obtained freedom with documents permitting civilian status were treated the same way.

sentences.zh: 余雖從良，並令津助本戶軍役。」

translations.literal: The remainder, though having obtained good standing, were all ordered to assist their original households' military service."
translations.idiomatic: The rest, even if freed, were still required to support their original households' military obligations."

sentences.zh: 七月，閱大都、京兆等處探馬赤戶名籍。

translations.literal: Seventh month: the name registers of tamachi households in the Great Capital, Jingzhao, and other places were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, tamachi household registers in the Great Capital, Jingzhao, and elsewhere were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔樞密：「諸路正軍貼戶及同籍親戚僮奴，丁年堪役，依諸王權要以避役者，並還之軍，惟匠藝精巧者以名聞。」

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Bureau of Military Affairs was edicted: "Principal and supplementary military households of the various circuits, and relatives, servants, and slaves of the same register, of age fit for service, who evaded service relying on princely privilege—all are to be returned to the armies; only those with exquisite artisan skill are to be reported by name."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered: "Principal and supplementary military households, and relatives, servants, and slaves on the same register, of serviceable age, who evaded duty under princely protection—all are to be returned to the armies; only those with exceptional artisan skill may be reported by name."

sentences.zh: 十二月，命府州司縣達魯花赤及治民長官，不妨本職，兼管諸軍奧魯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: darughachi of prefectures, subprefectures, departments, and counties and civil administrators were ordered, without hindering their principal duties, concurrently to oversee military ordu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, darughachi and civil administrators at prefectural and county level were ordered, without neglecting their regular duties, to oversee military ordu as well.

sentences.zh: 各路總管府達魯花赤、總管，別給宣命印信，府州司縣達魯花赤長官止給印信，任滿則別具解由，申樞密院。

translations.literal: Darughachi and chief administrators of general administrations of the various circuits were separately given imperial appointment seals; darughachi and chief officials of prefectures, subprefectures, departments, and counties received only seals; when terms expired they separately prepared discharge documents and reported to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi and chief administrators of circuit general administrations received separate imperial appointment seals; prefectural and county darughachi received seals only; on completing their terms they filed discharge documents with the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，合剌請於渠江之北雲門山及嘉陵西岸虎頭山立二戍，以其圖來上，仍乞益兵二萬，敕給京兆新簽軍五千人益之。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month: Hela requested establishing two garrisons at Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and Hutou Mountain on the west bank of the Jialing, submitted his map, and still begged twenty thousand additional troops; an order gave five thousand newly conscripted soldiers of Jingzhao as reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, Hela proposed two garrisons at Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and Hutou Mountain on the Jialing's west bank, submitted his map, and requested twenty thousand reinforcements; five thousand newly conscripted soldiers from Jingzhao were ordered as reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 陜西京兆、延安、鳳翔三路諸色人戶，約六萬戶內，簽軍六千。

translations.literal: Among households of various categories of the three circuits of Shaanxi Jingzhao, Yan'an, and Fengxiang—approximately sixty thousand households—six thousand soldiers were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: From roughly sixty thousand households of every category in the Jingzhao, Yan'an, and Fengxiang circuits, six thousand soldiers were drafted.

sentences.zh: 五月，禁乾討虜人，其願充軍者，於萬戶、千戶內結成牌甲，與大軍一體征進。

translations.literal: Fifth month: freebooting captors were forbidden; those willing to serve as soldiers were formed into platoons within commands of ten thousand and a thousand households and campaigned together with the main armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, freebooting was forbidden; those willing to enlist were organized into platoons under commanders of ten thousand and a thousand households and marched with the main armies.

sentences.zh: 八月，禁軍吏之長舉債，不得重取其息，以損軍力，違者罪之。

translations.literal: Eighth month: it was forbidden for military clerks and commanders to lend money and take heavy interest, thereby damaging military strength; violators were prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, military officers were forbidden to lend money at usurious rates to their men, weakening the forces; violators were prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 九月，襄陽生券軍至都釋械系免死，聽自立部伍，俾征日本，仍於蒙古、漢人內選官率領之。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Xiangyang life-certificate troops reached the capital, were disarmed and bound, granted exemption from death, permitted to form their own units, and made to campaign against Japan; officials were still selected from among Mongols and Han to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Xiangyang life-certificate troops reached the capital, were disarmed and spared execution, allowed to form their own units for the Japan campaign, with Mongol and Han officers selected to lead them.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，初立軍官以功升散官格。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, first month: for the first time regulations were established for military officers to advance in honorary ranks according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year, regulations were first established for promoting military officers to honorary ranks according to merit.

sentences.zh: 五月，便宜總帥府言：「本路軍經今四十年間，或死或逃，無丁不能起補，見在軍少，乞選擇堪與不堪丁力，放罷貧乏無丁者，於民站內別選充役。」

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Convenient Grand Marshal's headquarters reported: "This circuit's troops over the past forty years have died or fled; without adult males replacements cannot be raised; the troops presently existing are few. We beg to select those fit or unfit in bodily strength, release the poor without adult males, and separately select replacements from civilian relay households."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Convenient Grand Marshal's headquarters reported: "Over forty years our circuit's troops have died or fled; without sons we cannot fill the ranks, and our forces are thin. We ask to assess fitness, release poor households without sons, and select replacements from civilian relay households."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 詔延安府、沙井、凈州等處種田白達達戶，選其可充軍者，簽起出征。

translations.literal: An edict [declared that] farming White Tatar households of Yan'an Prefecture, Shajing, Jingzhou, and other places—those fit for military service were to be selected, conscripted, and sent on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that farming White Tatar households in Yan'an, Shajing, Jingzhou, and elsewhere who were fit for service be drafted and sent on campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，潁州屯田總管李珣言：「近為簽軍事，乞依徐、邳州屯田例，每三丁內，一丁防城，二丁納糧，可簽丁壯七百餘人，並元撥保甲丁壯，令珣通領，鎮守潁州，代見屯納合監戰軍馬別用。」

translations.literal: Sixth month: Li Xun, chief administrator of the Yingzhou military colony, reported: "Recently because of conscription affairs, we beg to follow the Xu and Pizhou military-colony precedent: of every three adult males, one garrisons the walls, two pay grain tax—we can conscript over seven hundred able-bodied men, together with the originally assigned baojia able-bodied men, place them all under Xun's command to garrison Yingzhou, replacing the present colony grain payments and separately supplying war horses for the supervisor."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Li Xun, chief of the Yingzhou military colony, reported: "Because of recent conscription, we ask to follow the Xu and Pizhou precedent: of every three adult males, one garrisons the walls and two pay grain tax. We can draft over seven hundred able-bodied men plus the assigned baojia men, place them under my command to garrison Yingzhou, replace present colony grain payments, and supply war horses separately."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，遣官往遼東，簽揀蒙古達魯花赤、千戶、百戶等官子弟出軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, third month: officials were dispatched to Liaodong to conscript and select sons and younger brothers of Mongol darughachi, commanders of a thousand households, commanders of a hundred households, and other officers for military service.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twelfth year, officials were sent to Liaodong to draft the sons and younger brothers of Mongol darughachi, thousand-household commanders, hundred-household commanders, and other officers.

sentences.zh: 詔隨處所置襄陽生券軍之為農者，或自願充軍，具數以聞。

translations.literal: An edict [declared that] among Xiangyang life-certificate soldiers stationed throughout the realm and engaged in farming, those willing to serve as soldiers were to report their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Xiangyang life-certificate soldiers farming throughout the realm who wished to enlist report their numbers.

sentences.zh: 五月，正陽萬戶劉復亨言：「新下江南三十餘城，俱守以兵，及江北、淮南、潤、揚等處未降，軍力分散，調度不給，以致鎮巢軍、滁州兩處復叛。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Liu Fuheng, commander of ten thousand households of Zhengyang, reported: "More than thirty newly subjugated cities in Jiangnan are all garrisoned with troops; moreover, north of the River, Huainan, Run, Yang, and other places have not yet surrendered. Military strength is scattered and supplies cannot be distributed, causing Zhenchao Army and Chuzhou to rebel again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Liu Fuheng, the Zhengyang commander of ten thousand households, reported: "Over thirty newly taken Jiangnan cities are all under garrison. With north-of-the-River, Huainan, Runzhou, and Yangzhou still unredeemed, our forces are spread thin and supplies cannot keep pace, and Zhenchao Army and Chuzhou have rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 乞簽河西等戶為軍，並力剿除，庶無後患。」

translations.literal: We beg to conscript households of Hexi and other regions as soldiers, join forces to suppress and eliminate [the rebels], and thereby avoid later trouble."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to draft households from Hexi and elsewhere as soldiers, combine forces to wipe them out, and forestall further trouble."

sentences.zh: 有旨，命肅州達魯花赤，並遣使同往驗各色戶計物力富強者簽起之。

translations.literal: An imperial order directed the darughachi of Suzhou and dispatched envoys to go together, inspect households of various categories, assess property and wealth, and conscript the prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered the Suzhou darughachi and envoys to inspect households of every category, assess their means, and draft the wealthy.

sentences.zh: 六月，簽平陽、西京、延安等路達魯花赤弟男為軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: younger brothers and sons of darughachi of the Pingyang, Xijing, Yan'an, and other circuits were conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, younger brothers and sons of darughachi in the Pingyang, Xijing, Yan'an, and other circuits were drafted.

sentences.zh: 萊州酒稅官王貞等上言：「國家討平殘宋，吊伐為事，何嘗以賄利為心。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen and others, wine-tax officials of Laizhou, memorialized: "The state in suppressing the remnant Song took punitive expedition as its purpose—when did it ever set its heart on bribes and profit?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen and other Laizhou wine-tax officials memorialized: "The state campaigned against the remnant Song to punish wrongdoing—never to chase bribes and profit.

sentences.zh: 彼不紹事業小人，貪圖貨利，作乾討虜名目，侵掠彼地，所得人口，悉皆貨賣，以充酒食之費，勝則無益朝廷，敗則實為辱國。

translations.literal: Those base men who do not carry on the enterprise, greedy for goods and profit, use the name of freebooting captors to raid those lands; the people they capture are all sold off to pay for wine and food. If they win, the court gains nothing; if they lose, they truly disgrace the state.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men who betray the enterprise, greedy for gain, raid under the name of freebooting captors and sell every captive for wine and food. Victory brings the court no benefit; defeat brings real disgrace upon the realm.

sentences.zh: 其招討司所收乾討虜人，可悉罷之，第其高下，籍為正軍，命各萬戶管領征進，一則得其實用，二則正王師吊伐之名，實為便益。」

translations.literal: The freebooting captors collected by the Pacification Commission may all be dismissed; rank them high and low, register them as principal soldiers, and order each commander of ten thousand households to lead them on campaign—first, to put them to real use; second, to restore the royal army's name for punitive expedition. This would truly be beneficial."
translations.idiomatic: The freebooters under the Pacification Commission should all be disbanded, ranked, registered as regular soldiers, and placed under commanders of ten thousand households for campaign—both to make them useful and to restore the royal army's name as a punitive force. The benefit would be real."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，詔：「上都、隆興、西京、北京四路編民捕獵等戶，簽選丁壯軍二千人，防守上都。」

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, first month, an edict: "From registered civilian hunting and other households of the four circuits of Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, and Bejing, two thousand able-bodied soldiers are to be conscripted and selected to garrison Shangdu."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourteenth year, an edict ordered two thousand able-bodied soldiers drafted from registered civilian and hunting households in the Shangdu, Longxing, Xijing, and Bejing circuits to garrison Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 中書省議：「從各路搭配，二十五戶內取軍一名，選善騎射者充，官給行資中統鈔一錠，仍自備鞍馬衣裝器仗，編立牌甲，差官部領，前來赴役。」

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated: "From each circuit, one soldier is to be taken from every twenty-five households; those skilled at riding and archery are to be selected. The state will give one ingot of Zhongtong paper money for travel expenses; they are still to provide their own saddles, horses, clothing, and weapons, be organized into platoons, led by dispatched officials, and come forward to serve."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat proposed drafting one soldier from every twenty-five households across the circuits, selecting skilled riders and archers, granting one ingot of Zhongtong paper money for travel, requiring them to furnish saddles, horses, gear, and arms, organizing them into platoons under appointed officers, and sending them to serve.

sentences.zh: 十二月，樞密院臣言：「收附亡宋州城，新附請糧官軍，並通事馬軍人等，軍官不肯存恤，多逃散者，乞招誘之。」

translations.literal: Twelfth month: officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "In subjugated former Song prefectures and cities, newly submitted grain-requisition troops and interpreter cavalry and others—because military officers would not care for them, many fled and scattered. We beg to recruit them back."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "In newly taken former Song cities, grain-requisition troops, interpreter cavalry, and others have scattered because officers failed to care for them. We ask permission to recruit them back."

sentences.zh: 命左丞陳巖等，分揀堪當軍役者，收系充軍，依舊例月支錢糧。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director Chen Yan and others were ordered to sort those fit for military service, take them in and enroll them as soldiers, and pay monthly stipends and grain according to the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Director Chen Yan and others were ordered to sort out those fit for service, enroll them as soldiers, and pay monthly stipends and grain as before.

sentences.zh: 其生券不堪當軍者，官給牛具糧食，屯田種養。

translations.literal: Those with life certificates unfit for military service were given oxen, implements, and grain by the state and put to farm in military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Life-certificate holders unfit for military duty were given oxen, tools, and grain by the state and assigned to military-colony farming.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，定軍官承襲之制。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, first month: regulations for hereditary succession of military officers were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year, regulations governing hereditary succession for military officers were established.

sentences.zh: 凡軍官之有功者升其秩，元受之職，令他有功者居之，不得令子侄復代。

translations.literal: For all military officers who had merit, their rank was raised; the original post they held was given to another meritorious man, and sons and nephews were not permitted to succeed in their place.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious officers were promoted in rank, but their original posts went to other men of merit; sons and nephews could not succeed them.

sentences.zh: 陣亡者始得承襲，病死者降一等。

translations.literal: Only those who died in battle might inherit; those who died of illness were reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary succession was granted only to those killed in battle; death from illness reduced the inheritable rank by one grade.

sentences.zh: 總把、百戶老病死，不在承襲之例。

translations.literal: Platoon leaders and commanders of a hundred households who died of old age or illness were not within the scope of hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon leaders and hundred-household commanders who died of old age or illness were not eligible for hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 凡將校臨陣中傷、還營病創者，亦令與陣亡之人一體承襲。

translations.literal: All officers and commanders wounded in battle or who returned to camp and died of their wounds were likewise granted hereditary succession equal to those who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Officers wounded in battle or who died of wounds after returning to camp were granted the same hereditary succession as those killed in action.

sentences.zh: 禁長軍之官不恤士卒，及士卒亡命避役，侵擾初附百姓者，俱有罪。

translations.literal: It was forbidden for senior military officers not to care for soldiers, and for soldiers to flee and evade service and harass newly submitted common people—all were guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officers who failed to care for their men, and soldiers who deserted to evade service and harassed newly submitted civilians, were all subject to punishment.

sentences.zh: 雲南行省言：「雲南舊屯駐蒙古軍甚少，遂取漸長成丁怯困都等軍，以備出征。

translations.literal: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat reported: "Formerly very few Mongol troops were stationed in Yunnan; therefore gradually maturing adult males from Qiedundu and other troops were taken to prepare for campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat reported: "Very few Mongol troops had been stationed in Yunnan, so gradually maturing men from the Qiedundu and other units were drafted for campaign.

sentences.zh: 雲南闊遠，多未降之地，必須用兵，已簽爨、僰人一萬為軍，續取新降落落、和泥等人，亦令充軍。

translations.literal: Yunnan is vast and remote, with many unsubjugated lands; troops must be used. Ten thousand Cuan and Bo people have already been conscripted as soldiers; newly submitted tribes, Hemi people, and others were also ordered to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan is vast and remote, with much territory still unredeemed, so troops are essential. Ten thousand Cuan and Bo people have already been drafted, and newly submitted tribes and Hemi people were also ordered to serve.

sentences.zh: 然其人與中原不同，若赴別地出征，必致逃匿，宜令就各所居一方未降處用之。」

translations.literal: Yet these people differ from those of the Central Plains; if sent to campaign in other regions, they will surely flee and hide. It is fitting to employ them in the unsubjugated places near where each group resides."
translations.idiomatic: But these people differ from those of the Central Plains; if sent to campaign elsewhere they will surely desert. They should be used against unsubjugated territory near their own homes."

sentences.zh: 九月，並軍士。

translations.literal: Ninth month: soldiers were consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, troops were consolidated.

sentences.zh: 初，至元九年簽軍三萬，止擇精銳年壯者，不復問其貲產，且無貼戶之助，歲久多貧乏不堪。

translations.literal: Initially, in the ninth year of Zhiyuan thirty thousand soldiers were conscripted; only the elite and young were chosen, their property was no longer considered, and there was no assistance from supplementary households. Over the years many became impoverished and could not endure it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in the ninth year of Zhiyuan thirty thousand soldiers had been drafted, selecting only the elite and young without regard to property and without supplementary household support. Over the years many had fallen into poverty and could not sustain service.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣奏，宜縱為民，遂並為一萬五千。

translations.literal: Officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized that they should be released to become civilians; they were therefore consolidated into fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs recommended releasing them to civilian status, and the rolls were consolidated to fifteen thousand.

sentences.zh: 諸軍戶投充諸侯王怯憐口、人匠，或托為別戶以避其役者，復令為軍，有良匠則別而出之。

translations.literal: Military households who had entered the service of princes as qielian dependents or artisans, or who relied on other households to evade service, were again ordered to serve as soldiers; those who were skilled artisans were separately released.
translations.idiomatic: Military households who had entered princely service as qielian dependents or artisans, or who registered under other households to evade duty, were returned to military service; skilled artisans were separately exempted.

sentences.zh: 樞密臣又言：「至元八年，於各路軍之為富商大賈者一百四十三戶，各增一軍，號余丁軍。

translations.literal: Officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs further reported: "In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, among military households in the various circuits who were great merchants, one hundred forty-three households each had one additional soldier added, called surplus-adult soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs added: "In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, one hundred forty-three wealthy merchant military households across the circuits each had an additional soldier added, called surplus-adult soldiers.

sentences.zh: 今東平等路諸奧魯總管府言，往往人死產乏，不能充二軍，乞免余丁充役者。」

translations.literal: Now the ordu chief administrators of Dongping and other circuits report that often people have died and property is exhausted, and they cannot fulfill two soldiers' service. They beg exemption for surplus-adult service."
translations.idiomatic: Now the ordu chief administrators of Dongping and other circuits report that deaths and depleted estates often leave households unable to supply two soldiers, and ask that surplus-adult service be waived."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，樞密院官議：「諸軍官在軍籍者，除百戶、總把權準軍役，其元帥、招討、萬戶、總管、千戶或首領官，俱合再當正軍一名。」

translations.literal: Twelfth month: officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: "Military officers on the military registers—apart from commanders of a hundred households and platoon leaders, who are provisionally counted as fulfilling military service—marshals, pacification commissioners, commanders of ten thousand households, chief administrators, commanders of a thousand households, and chief officers should all additionally furnish one principal soldier."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs ruled: "Officers on the military registers—except hundred-household commanders and platoon leaders, who provisionally count as fulfilling service—marshals, pacification commissioners, commanders of ten thousand households, chief administrators, thousand-household commanders, and chief officers must each additionally supply one principal soldier."

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，罷五翼探馬赤重役軍。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, first month: the heavy-corvée troops of the five tamachi wings were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year, the heavy-corvée troops of the five tamachi wings were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月，括兩淮造回回炮新附軍匠六百人，及蒙古、回回、漢人、新附人能造炮者，至京師。

translations.literal: Third month: six hundred newly submitted military artisans of the Two Huai who made Muslim artillery were rounded up, together with Mongols, Muslims, Han, and newly submitted persons able to make artillery, and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, six hundred newly submitted Two Huai artisans who made Muslim artillery were rounded up, along with Mongols, Muslims, Han, and newly submitted men skilled in artillery-making, and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月，淮西道宣慰司官昂吉兒請招諭亡宋通事軍，俾屬之麾下。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Angir, an official of the Huaixi Circuit Pacification Commission, requested to summon and persuade the former Song interpreter troops and place them under his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Angir of the Huaixi Circuit Pacification Commission asked to recruit former Song interpreter troops and place them under his command.

sentences.zh: 初，亡宋多招納北地蒙古人為通事軍，遇之甚厚，每戰皆列於前行，願效死力。

translations.literal: Initially, the fallen Song widely recruited Mongols from the northern lands as interpreter troops, treated them very generously, placed them in the front ranks in every battle, and they were willing to exert themselves unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the fallen Song had widely recruited northern Mongols as interpreter troops, treated them generously, placed them in the front ranks in every battle, and they fought willingly unto death.

sentences.zh: 及宋亡，無所歸。

translations.literal: When the Song fell, they had nowhere to go.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song fell, they had nowhere to go.

sentences.zh: 朝議欲編入版籍未暇也，人人疑懼，皆不自安。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on enrolling them in the registers but had not yet had time; everyone was suspicious and fearful, and none felt secure.
translations.idiomatic: The court had planned to enroll them in the registers but had not yet done so; they were all anxious and unsettled.

sentences.zh: 至是，昂吉兒請招集，列之行伍，以備征戍。

translations.literal: At this time Angir requested to gather them, array them in ranks, and prepare them for campaign and garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Angir asked to gather them, organize them into ranks, and prepare them for campaign and garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔河西地未簽軍之官，及富強戶有物力者，簽軍六百人。

translations.literal: Ninth month: an edict [ordered that] officials in Hexi who had not yet been conscripted and prosperous households with property were to supply six hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an edict ordered officials in Hexi not yet drafted and prosperous households with means to supply six hundred soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十月，壽州等處招討使李鐵哥，請召募有罪亡命之人充軍，其言：「使功不如使過。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Li Tiege, Pacification Commissioner of Shouzhou and other places, requested to recruit guilty fugitives to serve as soldiers, saying: "Employing merit is not as good as employing fault.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Li Tiege, Pacification Commissioner of Shouzhou and elsewhere, asked to recruit convicted fugitives as soldiers, saying: "It is better to use a man's fault than his merit.

sentences.zh: 始南宋未平時，蒙古、諸色人等，因得罪皆亡命往依焉，今已平定，尚逃匿林藪。

translations.literal: When the Southern Song had not yet been pacified, Mongols, people of various categories, and others, because they had offended, all fled as outlaws and went to rely on them. Now [the realm] is pacified, yet they still hide in forests and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Southern Song was pacified, Mongols and men of every category who had offended fled north to join them. Now the realm is settled, yet they still hide in the wilds.

sentences.zh: 若釋其罪而用之，必能效力，無不一當十者矣。」

translations.literal: If their crimes are pardoned and they are employed, they will surely exert themselves—none will fail to be worth ten ordinary men."
translations.idiomatic: If their crimes are pardoned and they are put to use, they will serve with all their strength—each worth ten ordinary men."

sentences.zh: 十一月，罷太原、平陽、西京、延安路新簽軍還籍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: newly conscripted soldiers of the Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an circuits were dismissed and returned to their registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, newly drafted soldiers from the Taiyuan, Pingyang, Xijing, and Yan'an circuits were released and returned to their home registers.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月，詔江淮諸路招集答剌罕軍。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, seventh month: an edict ordered the various circuits of Jianghuai to gather the darqan troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, an edict ordered the Jianghuai circuits to gather the darqan troops.

sentences.zh: 初平江南，募死士願從軍者，號答剌罕，屬之劉萬戶麾下。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan was first pacified, daredevils willing to join the army were recruited, called darqan, and placed under Commander Liu of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan was first pacified, volunteers willing to die for the cause were recruited as darqan and placed under Commander Liu of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 南北既混一，復散之，其人皆無所歸，率群聚剽掠。
