translations.literal: Once north and south were unified, they were again dispersed; those men all had nowhere to go and mostly gathered in bands to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Once north and south were unified, they were dispersed again; with nowhere to go, they banded together to plunder.

sentences.zh: 至是，命諸路招集之，令萬奴部領如故，聽範左丞、李拔都二人節制。

translations.literal: At this time an order directed the various circuits to gather them; Wan Nu was to lead them as before, subject to the control of Left Assistant Director Fan and Li Badu.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the circuits were ordered to gather them; Wan Nu was to lead them as before, under the supervision of Left Assistant Director Fan and Li Badu.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，並貧乏軍人三萬戶為一萬五千，取帖戶津帖正軍充役。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, second month: thirty thousand impoverished military households were consolidated into fifteen thousand; supplementary households were to subsidize principal soldiers who fulfilled service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year, thirty thousand impoverished military households were consolidated to fifteen thousand, with supplementary households subsidizing principal soldiers on active duty.

sentences.zh: 四月，置蒙古、漢人、新附軍總管。

translations.literal: Fourth month: chief administrators for Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, chief administrators were appointed for the Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies.

sentences.zh: 六月，樞密院議：「正軍貧乏無丁者，令富強丁多帖戶權充正軍應役，驗正軍物力，卻令津濟貼戶，其正軍仍為軍頭如故。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: "Where principal soldiers are impoverished and without adult males, prosperous supplementary households with many adult males are provisionally to serve as principal soldiers and fulfill duty; the principal soldier's property is to be assessed, and he is then to subsidize the supplementary household; the principal soldier still remains the military head as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs ruled: "Where principal soldiers are poor and without sons, prosperous supplementary households with many adult males may provisionally serve in their place; the principal soldier's property is assessed and used to subsidize the supplementary household, while the principal soldier remains the military head.

sentences.zh: 或正軍實系單丁者，許傭雇練習之人應役，丁多者不得傭雇，軍官亦不得以親從人代之。」

translations.literal: Or where a principal soldier truly has only one adult male, he may hire a trained person to fulfill service; those with many adult males may not hire substitutes, and military officers also may not use relatives or followers in their place."
translations.idiomatic: Where a principal soldier truly has only one adult male, he may hire a trained substitute; those with many sons may not hire substitutes, and officers may not use relatives or followers in their place."

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，諸侯王阿只吉遣使言：「探馬赤軍凡九處出征，各奧魯內復征雜泛徭役，不便。」

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, second month: Prince Ajiji sent envoys to report: "Tamachi troops have campaigned in nine places; within each ordu miscellaneous corvée is again levied—this is inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year, Prince Ajiji reported through envoys: "Tamachi troops have campaigned in nine places, yet each ordu still levies miscellaneous corvée—this is burdensome."

sentences.zh: 詔免之，並詔有司毋重役軍戶。

translations.literal: An edict exempted them, and also edicted the officials not to impose heavy corvée on military households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the exemption and ordered officials not to impose heavy corvée on military households.

sentences.zh: 六月，禁長軍之官，毋得占役士卒。

translations.literal: Sixth month: it was forbidden for senior military officers to occupy soldiers for private service.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, senior officers were forbidden to press soldiers into private service.

sentences.zh: 散定海答剌罕軍還各營，及歸戍城邑。

translations.literal: The Dinghai darqan troops were dispersed back to their respective camps and returned to garrison cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: The Dinghai darqan troops were dispersed to their camps and returned to garrison duty in cities and towns.

sentences.zh: 十月，簽發漸丁軍士。

translations.literal: Tenth month: gradually maturing adult soldiers were conscripted and dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, gradually maturing adult males were drafted for military service.

sentences.zh: 遵舊制，家止一丁者不作數，凡二丁至五丁、六丁之家，止存一人，餘皆充軍。

translations.literal: Following the old regulations, households with only one adult male did not count; households with two, up to five or six adult males kept one person and the rest all served as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old regulations, single-son households did not count; households with two to five or six adult males kept one son at home and drafted the rest.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月，命各處行樞密院造新附軍籍冊。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, second month: regional bureaus of military affairs were ordered to compile registers of newly submitted troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twentieth year, regional bureaus of military affairs were ordered to compile registers of newly submitted troops.

sentences.zh: 六月，從丞相伯顏議，所括宋手號軍八萬三千六百人，立牌甲，設官以統之。

translations.literal: Sixth month: following the deliberation of Chancellor Bayan, eighty-three thousand six hundred Song hand-marked troops who had been rounded up were organized into platoons and officials were established to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, following Chancellor Bayan's proposal, eighty-three thousand six hundred rounded-up Song hand-marked troops were organized into platoons under appointed officers.

sentences.zh: 十月，定出征軍人亡命之罪，為首者斬，余令減死一等。

translations.literal: Tenth month: the crime of desertion by troops on campaign was fixed—ringleaders were beheaded, the rest had death reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, penalties for desertion on campaign were fixed: ringleaders were beheaded, the rest had their death sentences reduced by one grade.

sentences.zh: 二十一年八月，江東道僉事馬奉訓言：「劉萬奴乾討虜軍，私相糾合，結為徒黨，張弓挾矢，或詐稱使臣，莫若散之各翼萬戶、千戶、百戶、牌甲內管領為便。」

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, eighth month: Ma Fengxun, Commissioner of the Jiangdong Circuit, reported: "Commander Liu's freebooting captor troops privately gather together, form factions, draw bows and carry arrows, and sometimes falsely claim to be envoys. It would be better to disperse them among the wings, commanders of ten thousand households, commanders of a thousand households, commanders of a hundred households, and platoons for management."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-first year, Ma Fengxun, Commissioner of the Jiangdong Circuit, reported: "Commander Liu's freebooting troops band together, draw bows, and sometimes pose as envoys. They should be dispersed among the wings, commanders of ten thousand, thousand, and hundred households, and platoons for proper control."

sentences.zh: 省院官以聞，有旨，可令問此軍：「欲從脫歡出征虜掠耶？

translations.literal: Provincial and bureau officials reported this; an imperial order directed that this army be asked: "Do you wish to follow Toghon on campaign to plunder captives?
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and bureau officials reported this; the throne ordered the troops asked: "Do you wish to follow Toghon on campaign to plunder?

sentences.zh: 欲且放散還家耶？」

translations.literal: Or do you wish to be temporarily dispersed and return home?"
translations.idiomatic: Or do you wish to be dispersed and sent home for now?"

sentences.zh: 回奏：「眾軍皆言，自圍襄樊渡江以來，與國效力，願令還家少息。」

translations.literal: They reported back: "All the troops say that since the siege of Xiang-Fan and the crossing of the River they have served the state and wish to be sent home for a brief rest."
translations.idiomatic: They reported back: "The troops say that since the siege of Xiangyang and Fan and the crossing of the River they have served the state faithfully and ask to be sent home for a brief rest."

sentences.zh: 遂從之。

translations.literal: The request was accordingly approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 籍亡宋手記軍。

translations.literal: The former Song hand-record troops were registered.
translations.idiomatic: The former Song hand-record troops were registered.

sentences.zh: 宋時有是軍，死則以兄弟若子承代。

translations.literal: Under the Song there was this army; when one died, a brother or son succeeded in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song this corps existed; when a soldier died, a brother or son took his place.

sentences.zh: 有旨，依漢軍例籍之，毋涅其手。

translations.literal: An imperial order directed that they be registered according to the Han army precedent, without tattooing their hands.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them registered under Han army regulations, without hand-tattooing.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，立行樞密院於江南三省，其各處行省見管軍馬悉以付焉。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, first month: a regional bureau of military affairs was established in the three provinces of Jiangnan; all troops presently under the various branch secretariats were entirely entrusted to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-second year, a regional bureau of military affairs was established in the three Jiangnan provinces, and all troops under the branch secretariats were placed under its command.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔福建黃華畬軍，有恒產者放為民，無恒產與妻子者編為守城軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month: an edict [declared that] among the Fujian Huang Hua She troops, those with fixed property were released to become civilians; those without fixed property, together with their wives and children, were enrolled as wall-garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that among the Fujian Huang Hua She troops, those with fixed property be released to civilian status, and those without property, together with their wives and children, be enrolled as wall-garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 征交趾蒙古軍五百人、漢軍二千人，除留蒙古軍百人、漢軍四百人，為鎮南王脫歡宿衛，余悉遣還，別以江淮行樞密院蒙古軍戍江西。

translations.literal: For the campaign against Jiaozhi there were five hundred Mongol troops and two thousand Han troops; apart from retaining one hundred Mongol troops and four hundred Han troops as personal guards for Prince of Zhennan Toghon, the rest were all sent back, and Mongol troops of the Jianghuai regional bureau of military affairs were separately garrisoned in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: For the Jiaozhi campaign there were five hundred Mongol and two thousand Han troops; one hundred Mongols and four hundred Han were kept as personal guards for Prince of Zhennan Toghon, the rest were sent home, and Jianghuai regional bureau Mongol troops were posted to garrison Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十月，從月的迷失言，以乾討虜軍七百人，籍名數，立牌甲，命將官之無軍者領之。

translations.literal: Tenth month: following Yede Shi's report, seven hundred freebooting captor troops were registered by name and number, organized into platoons, and officers without troops were ordered to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, following Yede Shi's proposal, seven hundred freebooting troops were registered, organized into platoons, and assigned to officers who had no troops under command.

sentences.zh: 十一月，御史臺臣言：「昔宋以無室家壯士為鹽軍，內附之初，有五千人，除征占城運糧死亡者，今存一千一百二十二人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: officials of the Censorate reported: "Formerly the Song made unmarried strong men into salt troops; at the beginning of submission there were five thousand; apart from those who died transporting grain on the Champa campaign, one thousand one hundred twenty-two now remain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Censorate officials reported: "The Song once made unmarried strong men into salt troops; when they first submitted there were five thousand; excluding those who died transporting grain on the Champa campaign, one thousand one hundred twenty-two remain.

sentences.zh: 此徒皆性習凶暴，民患苦之，宜給以衣糧，使屯田自贍，庶絕其擾。」

translations.literal: These people are all by nature accustomed to violence and brutality; the people suffer from them. They should be given clothing and grain, made to garrison-farm and support themselves, thus hopefully ending their predations."
translations.idiomatic: These men are habitually violent and brutal, and the people suffer under them. They should be given clothing and rations and put on garrison farms to support themselves, so as to end their harassment."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十二月，從樞密院請，嚴立軍籍條例，選壯士及有力之家充軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: following the Bureau of Military Affairs' request, military register regulations were strictly established, and strong men and wealthy households were selected to fill military service.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, at the Bureau of Military Affairs' request, strict military register regulations were enacted, and strong men and wealthy households were selected for conscription.

sentences.zh: 舊例，丁力強者充軍，弱者出錢，故有正軍、貼戶之籍。

translations.literal: By old precedent, those with strong adult-male labor served as soldiers and the weak paid money; hence there were registers of principal soldiers and supplementary households.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, households with strong adult males supplied soldiers while weaker ones paid subsidies, producing registers of principal military households and supplementary military households.

sentences.zh: 行之既久，而強者弱，弱者強，籍亦如故。

translations.literal: Implemented long, yet the strong became weak and the weak strong, while the registers remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: After long enforcement, the strong had weakened and the weak grown strong, yet the registers were left unchanged.

sentences.zh: 其同戶異居者，私立年期，以相更代，故有老稚不免從軍，而強壯家居者，至是革焉。

translations.literal: Those of the same household living separately privately set year-terms for mutual rotation, so the old and young could not avoid military service while strong adults remained at home—at this point this was reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Household members who lived apart privately arranged fixed terms of rotation, so the elderly and young were conscripted while able-bodied men stayed home—this was now abolished.

sentences.zh: 江浙省募鹽徒為軍，得四千七百六十六人，選軍官麾下無士卒者，相參統之，以備各處鎮守。

translations.literal: The Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat recruited salt convicts as soldiers, obtaining four thousand seven hundred sixty-six men; military officers under command with no troops were selected to jointly command them, to prepare for garrison duty in various places.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat recruited salt convicts as soldiers, mustering four thousand seven hundred sixty-six men, and assigned officers who had no troops under command to supervise them jointly for garrison duty throughout the province.

sentences.zh: 二十四年閏二月，樞密院臣言：「諸軍貼戶，有正軍已死者，有充工匠者，放為民者，有元系各投下戶回付者，似此歇閑一千三百四十戶，乞差人分揀貧富，定貼戶、正軍。」

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, intercalary second month: officials of the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Among supplementary military households of the various armies, some have principal soldiers already dead, some serve as artisans, some were released as civilians, and some were originally appanage households that were returned—such idle households number one thousand three hundred forty; we request dispatching persons to sort rich and poor and fix supplementary and principal households."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the twenty-fourth year, Bureau of Military Affairs officials reported: "Among supplementary military households, some principal soldiers are dead, some serve as artisans, some were released to civilian status, and some were appanage households returned to the rolls—altogether one thousand three hundred forty idle households. We ask that officials be sent to sort them by wealth and fix supplementary and principal household assignments."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年八月，樞密院議：「諸管軍官萬戶、千戶、百戶等，或治軍有法、鎮守無虞、鎧仗精完、差役均平、軍無逃竄者，許所司薦舉以聞，不次擢用。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, eighth month: the Bureau of Military Affairs deliberated: "Commanders of ten thousand households, commanders of a thousand households, commanders of a hundred households, and other officers in charge of troops—those who govern troops by proper methods, garrison without incident, keep armor and weapons in excellent condition, distribute corvée evenly, and have no desertions—may be recommended by the responsible office and reported upward for exceptional promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-sixth year, the Bureau of Military Affairs ruled: "Officers from commanders of ten thousand households down to commanders of a hundred households who govern troops well, garrison without incident, keep arms in good order, distribute duties fairly, and suffer no desertions may be recommended by their superiors for exceptional promotion.

sentences.zh: 諸軍吏之長，非有上司之命，毋擅離職。

translations.literal: Heads of army clerks, without orders from a superior, must not leave their posts on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Head clerks of military units must not leave their posts without orders from a superior.

sentences.zh: 諸長軍者，及蒙古、漢軍，毋得妄言邊事。」

translations.literal: Senior military officers, and Mongol and Han troops, must not speak rashly of frontier affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Senior officers and Mongol and Han troops alike must not speak recklessly about frontier affairs."

sentences.zh: 成宗大德二年十二月，定各省提調軍馬官員。

translations.literal: Emperor Chengzong, second year of Dade, twelfth month: officials for dispatching and commanding troops in each province were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Dade under Emperor Chengzong, regulations were set for provincial officials authorized to dispatch and command troops.

sentences.zh: 凡用隨從軍士，蒙古長官三十名，次官二十名，漢人一十名；

translations.literal: For all attendant soldiers used, Mongol senior officials thirty men, deputy officials twenty men, Han ten men;
translations.idiomatic: Attendant soldiers were limited to thirty for Mongol senior officials, twenty for deputy officials, and ten for Han officials;

sentences.zh: 萬戶、千戶、百戶人等，俱不得占役。

translations.literal: commanders of ten thousand households, commanders of a thousand households, commanders of a hundred households, and the like—all may not press them into private service.
translations.idiomatic: commanders of ten thousand, thousand, and hundred households alike were forbidden to press them into private service.

sentences.zh: 行省鎮撫止用聽探外，亦不得多余役占。

translations.literal: Branch secretariat pacification commissioners, apart from scouts and listeners, also may not exceed this in pressing soldiers into service.
translations.idiomatic: Branch secretariat pacification commissioners, apart from scouts and listeners, were likewise forbidden to press soldiers into excess private service.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，詔禮店軍還屬土番宣慰司。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, fourth month: an edict returned the Lidian troops to the Tufan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, an edict returned the Lidian garrison to the Tufan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 初，西川也速叠兒、按住奴、帖木兒等所統探馬赤軍，自壬子年屬籍禮店，隸王相府，後王相府罷，屬之陜西省，桑哥奏屬土番宣慰司，咸以為不便，大德十年命依壬子之籍，至是復改屬焉。

translations.literal: Initially, the tamachi troops commanded by Yesudiar, Anzhunu, Temür, and others in Western Sichuan, from the renzi year were registered to Lidian and subordinate to the prince-chancellor's office; later, when the prince-chancellor's office was abolished, they were placed under the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; Sangge memorialized to place them under the Tufan Pacification Commission—all regarded this as inconvenient; in the tenth year of Dade an order directed following the renzi registration; at this point they were again reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the tamachi troops under Yesudiar, Anzhunu, Temür, and others in Western Sichuan had been registered to Lidian in the renzi year and placed under the prince-chancellor's office. After that office was abolished they passed to the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; Sangge then proposed assigning them to the Tufan Pacification Commission, which all regarded as unsuitable. In the tenth year of Dade an order restored the renzi registration; now they were reassigned once again.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大元年正月，以通惠河千戶劉粲所領運糧軍九百二十人，屬萬戶赤因帖木爾兵籍。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong, first year of Zhida, first month: the nine hundred twenty grain-transport troops led by Commander of a Thousand Households Liu Can on the Tonghui Canal were assigned to the military register of Commander of Ten Thousand Households Chiyin Temür.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Zhida under Emperor Wuzong, the nine hundred twenty grain-transport troops under Tonghui Canal commander of a thousand households Liu Can were transferred to the military register of commander of ten thousand households Chiyin Temür.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丞相三寶奴等言：「國制，行省佐貳及宣慰使不得提調軍馬，若遙授平章、揚州宣慰使阿憐帖木兒者，嘗與成宗同乳母，故得行之，非常憲也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Chancellor Sanbaonu and others reported: "By national regulation, branch secretariat deputies and pacification commissioners may not dispatch and command troops; the remotely commissioned Grand Councillor and Yangzhou Pacification Commissioner Arin Temür, who shared a wet nurse with Chengzong, was therefore able to do so—it was not regular law.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Chancellor Sanbaonu and others reported: "By national law, branch secretariat deputies and pacification commissioners may not dispatch and command troops. Arin Temür, the remotely commissioned grand councillor and Yangzhou pacification commissioner, had been allowed to do so only because he shared a wet nurse with Chengzong—it was not regular practice.

sentences.zh: 今命沙的代之，宜遵國制，勿令提調。」

translations.literal: Now Shadi has been ordered to replace him; the national regulation should be followed, and he should not be permitted to dispatch and command troops."
translations.idiomatic: Shadi has now been appointed in his place; national law should be followed, and he must not be allowed to dispatch and command troops."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皇慶元年三月，中書省臣奏李馬哥等四百戶為民。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong, first year of Huangqing, third month: officials of the Central Secretariat memorialized that the four hundred households of Limaoge and others be made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Huangqing under Emperor Renzong, Central Secretariat officials memorialized that the four hundred households of Limaoge and others be restored to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 初，李馬哥等四百戶屬諸侯王脫脫，乙未年定籍為民，高麗林衍及乃顏叛，皆嘗簽為軍。

translations.literal: Initially, the four hundred households of Limaoge and others belonged to the princely lord Toto; in the yimi year they were fixed in the register as civilians; when the Koryo Lin Yan and Nayan rebelled, they were all once conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the four hundred households of Limaoge and others had belonged to Prince Toto; in the yimi year they were registered as civilians, but during the Koryo Lin Yan and Nayan rebellions they had all been conscripted.

sentences.zh: 至元八年置軍籍，以李馬哥等非七十二萬戶內軍數，復改為民。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan military registers were established; because Limaoge and others were not within the military quota of the seven hundred twenty thousand households, they were again changed to civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, when military registers were established, Limaoge and others were excluded from the military quota drawn from the seven hundred twenty thousand registered households and again made civilians.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，樞密院復奏為軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, the Bureau of Military Affairs again memorialized to make them soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida the Bureau of Military Affairs again memorialized to conscript them.

sentences.zh: 至是，省官以為言，命遵乙未年已定之籍。

translations.literal: At this point provincial officials spoke on the matter; an order directed following the register fixed in the yimi year.
translations.idiomatic: On this occasion provincial officials raised the issue, and an order directed that the register fixed in the yimi year be followed.

sentences.zh: 後樞密復奏，竟以為軍戶。

translations.literal: Later the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized again, and in the end they were made military households.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized again later, and they were ultimately registered as military households.

sentences.zh: 十二月，省臣言：「先是樞密院奏準，雲南省宜遵各省制，其省官居長者二員，得佩虎符，提調軍馬，余佐貳者不得預，已受虎符者悉收之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: provincial officials reported: "Earlier the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized and was approved: Yunnan Branch Secretariat should follow the regulations of the other provinces—its two senior provincial officials may wear tiger tallies and dispatch and command troops; the remaining deputies may not participate; those who had already received tiger tallies were all to have them collected.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, provincial officials reported: "The Bureau of Military Affairs had earlier been approved in ruling that Yunnan should follow other provinces' regulations: its two senior officials might wear tiger tallies and dispatch and command troops, while deputies might not participate; all tiger tallies already issued were to be collected.

sentences.zh: 今雲南省言，本省籍軍士之力，以辦集錢谷，遇有調遣，則省官親率眾上馬，故舊制雖牧民官亦得佩虎符，領軍務，視他省為不同。

translations.literal: Now the Yunnan Branch Secretariat states that this province relies on the strength of registered soldiers to collect revenue and grain; when there is a dispatch, provincial officials personally lead the masses to mount horses; therefore under the old system even civil administrators could wear tiger tallies and oversee military affairs—regarded as different from other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat now replied that the province relied on registered soldiers to collect revenue and grain, and that when troops were dispatched provincial officials personally led them into the field; under the old system even civil administrators had worn tiger tallies and commanded military affairs, making Yunnan unlike other provinces.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，已受虎符者依故事，未受者宜頒賜之。」

translations.literal: We deliberated: those who already received tiger tallies should follow precedent; those who had not received them should be granted them."
translations.idiomatic: We recommend that those who already hold tiger tallies retain them under precedent, and that those who do not should be issued them."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，詔：「雲南省鎮遠方，掌邊務，凡事涉軍旅者，自平章至僚佐須同署押，其長官二員，復與哈必赤。」

translations.literal: Second year, first month: an edict [declared]: "The Yunnan Branch Secretariat guards a distant frontier and handles border affairs; for all matters involving military affairs, from the Grand Councillor down to the staff assistants joint signing and sealing is required; its two leading officials are also granted qabichi status."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, an edict ordered: "The Yunnan Branch Secretariat guards a distant frontier and handles border affairs; all military matters, from the grand councillor down to the staff, require joint signature and seal; its two senior officials are also granted qabichi status."

sentences.zh: 延祐元年二月，四川省軍官闕員，詔：「依民官遷調之制，差人與本省提調官及監察御史同銓註。」

translations.literal: First year of Yanyou, second month: Sichuan Branch Secretariat military officer vacancies—an edict [declared]: "Following the transfer system for civilian officials, dispatch persons together with this province's officials for dispatching and commanding troops and the surveillance censor jointly to select and appoint."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yanyou, with military officer vacancies in the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, an edict ordered: "Following the transfer system for civilian officials, envoys are to be dispatched to select and appoint candidates jointly with the province's troop-dispatch officials and the surveillance censor."

sentences.zh: 三年三月，命伯顏都萬戶府及紅胖襖總帥府各調軍九千五百人，往諸侯王所，更代守邊士卒。

translations.literal: Third year, third month: the Bayan Chief Commander of Ten Thousand Households Office and the Hongpang'ao Marshal's Headquarters were each ordered to mobilize nine thousand five hundred troops to the princely lords' posts to relieve border garrison soldiers on rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, the Bayan Chief Commander of Ten Thousand Households Office and the Hongpang'ao Marshal's Headquarters were each ordered to mobilize nine thousand five hundred troops to the princes' posts to relieve border garrisons on rotation.

sentences.zh: 其屬都萬戶府者，軍一名，馬三匹；

translations.literal: Those subordinate to the chief commander of ten thousand households office: one soldier, three horses;
translations.idiomatic: Troops from the chief commander of ten thousand households office were to supply one soldier and three horses each;

sentences.zh: 屬總帥府者，軍一名，馬二匹。

translations.literal: those subordinate to the marshal's headquarters: one soldier, two horses.
translations.idiomatic: those from the marshal's headquarters, one soldier and two horses each.

sentences.zh: 令人自為計，其貧不能自備者，則命行伍之長及百戶、千戶等助之。

translations.literal: Each man was to provide for himself; those too poor to equip themselves were ordered to be assisted by squad leaders and commanders of a hundred and a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Each man was to equip himself; those too poor to do so were to be assisted by squad leaders and commanders of a hundred and a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 悉遣精銳練習騎射之士。

translations.literal: All dispatched were elite troops practiced in mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Only elite troops trained in mounted archery were sent.

sentences.zh: 每軍一百名，百戶一員；

translations.literal: For every one hundred soldiers, one commander of a hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: For every hundred soldiers there was to be one commander of a hundred households;

sentences.zh: 五百名，千戶一員。

translations.literal: for every five hundred, one commander of a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: for every five hundred, one commander of a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 復命買住、囊加<角┦>二人分左右部領之。

translations.literal: Buyiju and Nangjiadai were again ordered to command them in left and right divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Buyiju and Nangjiadai were appointed to command the left and right divisions respectively.
